groups.reference: reference start (not real time), not ranked

fair.rh_policy: RH ranked only among models with their own 2 m humidity; models whose humidity is estimated from the lowest pressure level are scored on the same cases and listed after the ranking
fair.start_policy: AI and physics models run here start from the GFS analysis (Hadi's rule for the daily site); downloaded products start from their centre's own analysis; post-processed products are built from other forecasts
notes: Ensemble means are smoother, which lowers RMSE; compare them within their group.
Post-processed products are trained or calibrated on observations; the rest is raw model output.
Physics models run here use our setup (GFS start, no own data assimilation): scores mean 'as run here'.
Every model is scored from the 9 Nov 2026 00 UTC cycle on, on one common set of station times per variable (same rules as the weekly table).

rainfallAI, rainfallAI-T and rainfallAI-W were frozen on 8 Nov 2026: the scripts and every model checkpoint they load are checked against the recorded checksums each day; a later change would be logged and restart that model's clean window. The table is final once 7 cycles have all 7 lead days verified.
Start data as on the daily site: models run here start from the GFS analysis, downloaded products from their centre's own analysis.
Cycles less than 7 days old add only their already verified lead days; every model shares the same cases.
